body:
Adds `research/swe-allocate`: uniform, greedy, bootstrap Thompson and knapsack-UCB replayed on swe-value scores. Greedy/Thompson reach ~75–83% of oracle vs ~60% for uniform, but value per line drifts down in 4 of 7 tracks, so results are an upper bound; preliminary, no live trial, no policy adopted. 6 tests pass, `python site/build.py` prints ok.
